messages.subject: tsDyn: new version 0.9
messages.body_plain:
Hi

The tsDyn package, for nonlinear time series analysis in R, has been recently updated to version 0.9, and shortly after minor update 0.9-1.

The main changes concern extended univarate forecasting methods, as well as multivariate linear VAR/VECM forecasting and rank testing functions.

For univariate nonlinear models, forecasting can now be done with bootstrap/Monte-Carlo, which is important since the usual "no residuals" forecast is biased in non-linear models.

For multivariate linear models, a whole set of new functions is available. A predict() method has been added, which can be used on additional "newdata", allowing to do rolling forecasts (which is not possible in vars/urca). Rolling forecasts are made easier with the predict_rolling() function. Furthermore, methods IRF and FEVD from urca pkg can be used with the tsDyn object. Finally, the Johansen rank test is now also available, and it gives p-values instead of critical values as in urca. Besides of that, another rank testing procedure, based on information criteria, has been introduced, which allows joint estimation of the lags and rank. See rank.select().

The detailed changelog can be accessed under:
http://stat.ethz.ch/CRAN/web/packages/tsDyn/ChangeLog

Best

Matthieu
